From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: stakeholder map & proposed MAP (draft attached)

Thanks again for your time today, Sarah -- really appreciate the high-level overview of FinPay's roadmap and the procurement cadence. Per our call, summary and next steps below.

Recap (30 min discovery)
- Use case recap: real-time fraud analysis prompts + payment reconciliation summaries for mid-market merchants.
- Key decision criteria: predictability of per-token cost, on-prem/private deployment option, SOC2 + audit logs, SLA for latency.
- Timeline: procurement kickoff late June, procurement review in early July, target pilot in Aug.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Stakeholder map: can you confirm economic buyer and primary legal/procurement contacts? (I noted Sarah T. as program owner).
2) Security questionnaire: I attached our Redwood security brief; we'll prepare SOC2 artifacts and provide a redacted runbook if they'd like.
3) MAP (mutual action plan): attached a draft (FinPay-MAP-v1.pdf). If you confirm stakeholders and timelines I will turn this into a milestone-ready MAP and propose dates.
4) Suggested follow-up: 30-min MAP review + procurement Q&A next week - propose Tue 6/22 or Thu 6/24.

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-v1.pdf, redwood-security-brief.pdf

Thanks -- looking forward to next steps.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Procurement lead: procurement@finpay.com (TBD: primary contact is Jenna in procurement, I'll intro on Monday).

I'll attach the procurement checklist we use internally - helps for mutual action planning. I can also intro you to Jenna (procurement) and Aaron (InfoSec) on Monday.

Subject: Updated MAP (v2) + proposed milestones - please review

Sarah -- thanks for the stakeholder list and procurement timing. I've updated the MAP with the stakeholders you listed and added milestone dates that align with your expected procurement window. See attached FinPay-MAP-v2.pdf. High level milestones below:

Mutual Action Plan (summary)
- Week of Jun 21: MAP review meeting (30 min) - agree milestones & owners.
- Jul 5-9: Procurement review (FinPay procurement).
- Jul 12-16: Legal review & contract redlines (Mark Rivera).
- Jul 19-30: Implementation planning & SOW sign-off (internal).
- Aug 2-Aug 20: Pilot (test dataset + 2-week evaluation).

Action items for FinPay
- Confirm primary procurement contact (Jenna) and loop in legal + InfoSec for the MAP review meeting.
- Complete procurement checklist (you already started - thanks).

Action items for Redwood
- Provide SOC2 artifacts and redacted runbook by Jul 1.
- Prep technical onboarding checklist and pilot success criteria.

Proposed MAP review meeting: Tue 6/22 @ 10:00am PT or Thu 6/24 @ 11:00am PT - please confirm which works best for Michael/Mark/Jenna/Aaron. If neither works, propose two alternatives.

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-v2.pdf, redwood-sow-template.docx

Thanks -- I'll iterate quickly once I have procurement and legal on the thread.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Mark Rivera <mrivera@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Thompson <sarah.thompson@finpay.com>
Cc: procurement@finpay.com
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP (v2) + proposed milestones - please review

Marissa/Sarah -- quick note from legal: we reviewed the high-level MAP and the proposed milestones look fine. A couple items to flag for contract language:
- Data residency: need explicit clause around log retention and ability to delete customer data on request.
- Subprocessor list / vendor audits: provide current subprocessor list and SOC2 coverage details.
- Limitation of liability: we'll propose a standard cap that legal will circulate during redlines.

Procurement timeline works - we expect to start redlines the week of Jul 12 after procurement completes initial review. I will join the MAP review meeting if timing allows.

Thanks,
Mark Rivera
Senior Counsel | FinPay
